name: lychee

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Fast link checker for markdown files and websites
installHint: Install lychee from GitHub releases: https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee/releases — or via cargo install lychee, or brew install lychee

windows.evidence: A mechanism exists but no implementation is wired for this host OS.
